geography: California, statewide -- every operator on Cal-ITP's nightly ingest list
time_coverage: current statewide snapshot; refreshed and republished monthly (CKAN accrualPeriodicity R/P1M)
schema_and_format: CSV keyed on (base64_url, trip_id, start_time), carrying end_time, headway_secs, exact_times. ACQUIRED PURELY AS AN EXCLUSION LIST, which is why a 15 KB file gets its own governance record. For a frequency-defined trip, the stop_times row is a TEMPLATE of relative offsets, not an absolute schedule -- the trip actually runs many times between start_time and end_time at headway_secs. Chaining such a trip by its template times would place a vehicle at a clock time it never occupies and manufacture a deadhead gap that does not exist. Every trip appearing here is excluded from the derivation and counted separately, rather than being silently mis-timed.
update_frequency: monthly (CKAN accrualPeriodicity R/P1M). source_checksum is null -- trust-on-first-use.
canonical_contract: none-yet -- a negative filter, not data Milexium maps onto any canonical entity. Its whole job is to keep rows OUT of app.canonical.entities.DeadheadSegment.

quality_tests.name: header_carries_trip_key_and_headway
quality_tests.description: the first line contains base64_url, trip_id and headway_secs -- the trip key is what the exclusion joins on

quality_tests.name: exclusion_list_is_small_relative_to_trips
quality_tests.description: the distinct excluded (base64_url, trip_id) count is a small fraction of all trips; if frequency-defined trips ever dominate, the headline deadhead figure would be describing a small minority of service and must say so

acceptance_threshold: downloads over plain HTTPS with no credential, is CSV, and the header contains base64_url, trip_id and headway_secs. An EMPTY body (header only) is an acceptable outcome and means no California feed uses frequency-based service -- it is not a download failure.
retention_and_deletion: retain: 15 KB, and losing it would silently re-admit mis-timed trips into the derivation. Reproducible monthly.
